headline: A single-pack day: Qualys defaults LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN_DATETIME when the field is missing
summary_md:
- One pack moves for one upstream commit (+78/-1) — the quietest content day of the past fortnight.
- **qualys** supplies a default for `LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN_DATETIME` when the field is absent (#45681).
- 78 insertions against a single deletion: handling was added, not rewritten.
- No pack was added or removed.

highlights.title: Qualys no longer depends on LAST_VM_AUTH_SCAN_DATETIME being present
highlights.detail: #45681 is the day's only change, and its single deletion against 78 insertions marks it as new handling for the absent-field case rather than a replacement of existing logic.
